question: Most of the chromite deposits in India are found in:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Odisha.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Odisha contributes around 90% of the total production of chromite in the country.**
 
• **Chromite **is the only economic ore of chromium which is an oxide of iron and chromium which is used in chrome plating and alloying for the production of various materials such as corrosion-resistant superalloys, nichrome, stainless steel, etc.
 
• It is used for the production of Disodium that is necessary for the production of stainless steel.
 
• Apart from Odisha, **Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Jharkhand, and Karnataka** also contribute to chromite production in the country.
 
• **Karnataka is the second-largest producer of chromite.**
